title: 第3章 植物亲和与武者之躯第4章 巫师学徒之威
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 伊森在狂热的声浪中转身，穿过城堡大门。
回到房间，关上厚重的橡木门，将喧嚣彻底隔绝。
【添加第4个被动，消耗8点生命能量。是否确认？】
【生成完成，获得被动：植物亲和。】
【植物亲和：可与所有植物建立微弱联系，感知植物的状态，加速植物生长，可从植物中汲取微弱的生命力。】
伊森挑了挑眉，没太在意。
【添加第5个被动，消耗16点生命能量。是否确认？】
【生成完成，获得被动：武者躯体。】
【武者躯体：生命力翻倍，反应速度提升30%，肉体类修炼法门修炼速度提升5000%。】
肉体类修炼法门修炼速度提升......
从六岁开始修炼呼吸法，整整十年，如今还只是预备骑士，距离真正踏入骑士阶层还差临门一脚。
按照正常进度，少则半年，多则一年。
伊森闭上眼，双腿分开，开始运转呼吸法。
刚运转第一遍，身体内部就涌出一股温热的气息，在四肢百骸流淌。
第二遍，肌肉开始微微颤动，骨骼发出细微的噼啪声。
腹部深处，仿佛有什么东西破碎了。
一股远比之前更加汹涌的生命能量骤然喷发，如同溃堤的洪水，瞬间席卷全身。
content_en:
Ethan turned around amid the frantic sound and walked through the castle gate.
Go back to your room and close the heavy oak door to completely isolate yourself from the noise.
"Add passive."
[Add a fourth passive, consuming 8 points of life energy. Confirm? 】
"Confirm."
[Energy deduction: 8 points. Current energy: 18 points. 】
[Generating passive...]
[Generation completed, acquired passive: plant affinity. 】
[Plant Affinity: Can establish weak connections with all plants, sense the status of plants, accelerate plant growth, and draw weak vitality from plants. 】
Ethan raised his eyebrows and didn't pay much attention.
"Add passive."
[Add a fifth passive, consuming 16 points of life energy. Confirm? 】
"Confirm."
[Energy deduction: 16 points. Current energy: 2 points. 】
[Generating passive...]
[Generation completed, obtain passive: warrior body. 】
[Warrior Body: Double the vitality, increase the reaction speed by 30%, and increase the physical training speed by 5000%. 】
Ethan's pupils suddenly contracted.
Life force doubled.
The reaction speed is increased by 30%.
The speed of physical training methods is increased...
5000%? ? ?
Fifty times?
He froze in place.
He has been practicing breathing techniques since he was six years old. It has been ten years. Now he is still a preliminary knight, and he is still one step away from truly stepping into the knight class.
According to the normal progress, it can take as little as half a year and as much as one year.
And now——
Ethan closed his eyes, spread his legs, and began to perform breathing techniques.
Inhale, slowly and deeply.
Exhale, short and strong.
Just after the first operation, a warm breath surged out of the body and flowed through the limbs.
The second time, the muscles began to tremble slightly and the bones made a subtle crackling sound.
The third time...
Boom!
Deep in his abdomen, something seemed to be broken.
A far more turbulent life energy than before suddenly erupted, like a flood that broke a bank, sweeping across the whole body in an instant.
